external_entities.name: developer
external_entities.description: A developer who pushes branches and can manually trigger rebuilds.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
external_entities.notes: Any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand; that path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

external_entities.name: public package registry
external_entities.description: The public package registry reached during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: build runner
processes.description: Picks up merges, fetches source, resolves the dependency lockfile, produces container images, pushes images, and calls the deploy controller.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.
processes.notes: Any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand; that path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.

processes.name: deploy controller
processes.description: Maintains the current release image SHA for the estate and answers store-server release queries.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.

processes.name: store server
processes.description: A small back-office server that runs the till software container and periodically checks for and retrieves the current release.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.
processes.notes: The store servers do not get pushed to. Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is, and if it differs from what it is running it pulls that image from the registry and restarts the container.

processes.name: till software
processes.description: Software running as a container on each store server.
processes.source_excerpt: running the till software as a container

data_stores.name: self-hosted git server
data_stores.description: The self-hosted Git server receiving developer branches and merges.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server, which sits on the corporate network.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the git server encrypts what it stores.

data_stores.name: image registry
data_stores.description: The registry holding finished container images tagged with commit SHAs.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores. The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: A developer sends branch contents to the self-hosted git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: start build
data_flows.description: The self-hosted git server starts a build after a merge to main.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A merge to `main` is what starts a build.

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: The build runner fetches source from the self-hosted git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: The build runner obtains dependencies from the public package registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The lockfile is taken as given — the runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

data_flows.name: publish image
data_flows.description: The build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: finished container image tagged with the commit SHA

data_flows.name: set release
data_flows.description: The build runner asks the deploy controller to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When the image is pushed the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release.
data_flows.notes: The token the runner uses to call the controller is a shared build token that is the same for every pipeline and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.
data_flows.data_description: container image SHA and shared build token

data_flows.name: check release
data_flows.description: A store server asks the deploy controller for the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: A store server pulls the current image from the image registry when its release differs.
data_flows.source_excerpt: if it differs from what it is running it pulls that image from the registry
data_flows.notes: The image registry is reachable from the store estate over the WAN. Nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.
data_flows.data_description: container image tagged with the commit SHA

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network hosting the self-hosted git server and deploy controller.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: which sits on the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: build environment
trust_boundaries.description: The separate environment hosting the build runner and image registry.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The runner lives in its own build environment, separate from the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: store estate
trust_boundaries.description: The estate containing the store servers.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The image registry is reachable from the store estate over the WAN.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The public internet hosting the public package registry.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the public package registry on the internet

assumptions.assumption: The source code held by the self-hosted git server is commercially sensitive and therefore confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store holds developer branches and source code, which is treated as business-sensitive software content.

assumptions.assumption: The container images held by the image registry are commercially sensitive and therefore confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store holds finished container images used to deploy the till software across the estate.
